name: 68-shuyu
description: Shuyu: a red-feathered chicken with four small heads on four necks, red combs and yellow beaks, six yellow feet and three dark red tails. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place, its four heads peck at the air two at a time: one front head jabs forward while a back head jabs straight up, then the other two heads do the same. Body, feet and tails stay still. Same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. Seen from behind: the backs of the heads only, no faces.

flap.action: Big wingbeat in place: both red wings flung straight up high above its back, then swept far out to the sides and down below its body, then back up. A large clear wing movement every frame. Heads, body and feet stay still, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
